purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed NYC flight departure records for January through June 2013 from JFK, LGA, and EWR, ready for downstream analytics on schedule adherence and delay performance.
usage: Consumers should treat nulls in departure_time, arrival_time, departure_delay_minutes, arrival_delay_minutes, air_time_minutes, and tail_number as flights that never departed, never arrived, or lack a recorded tail number, and handle them deliberately rather than assuming zero or an error; the declared grain of year, month, day, carrier_code, flight_number, and scheduled_departure_time should be validated against the warehouse before being relied on as a unique key.
limitations: year, month, and day remain three separate integer columns rather than a single DATE column because no merge action is available in this cleanup pass; roughly 2.9%-3.3% of departure_time, arrival_time, the two delay columns, and air_time_minutes are null (null_rate 0.029388-0.032981), and 0.9% of tail_number values are null (null_rate 0.009154), none of which were imputed or dropped.
